name: agent-automations
description: Use this skill when the user wants an agent to run automatically — on a recurring schedule (e.g. every day at 8am) or whenever an external system calls a URL. It covers creating scheduled cron jobs and HTTP triggers for an agent, converting the user's time to UTC, and making the agent deliver its output (e.g. posting to a Slack channel).
human_description: Teaches an agent how to set up scheduled and HTTP-triggered automations for other agents.
